name: tax-table-single-25225
description: Single filer whose taxable income is exactly the midpoint of the published Tax Table row 25,200-25,250. The published row value is $2,789; the engine's exact bracket computation at the midpoint is $2,788.50, within the IRS whole-dollar row rounding.

source.publication: Instructions for Form 1040 (2025), 2025 Tax Table, single column, row 'At least 25,200 / But less than 25,250'
source.pin: Tax Table rows are computed at the $50-range midpoint and published rounded to whole dollars. Row 25,200-25,250, Single column: $2,789.

derivation: Standard deduction (single, 2025): $15,750. Taxable income = 40,975 - 15,750 = $25,225 (the midpoint of Tax Table row 25,200-25,250).
Exact bracket tax = 1,192.50 + 1,596.00 = $2,788.50; the published Tax Table row shows $2,789 (whole-dollar rounding). Tolerance 0.505 covers the IRS row-rounding convention.
